headline: What's behind the Google AI shakeup
summary: Google's AI team recently saw significant personnel changes. Legendary Googler Jeff Dean is among those who have left. This shakeup raises questions as Google's AI models are highly competitive.

headline: Sony could release a cheaper version of its WH-1000XM4 headphones, according to leaks
summary: Sony may launch a more affordable version of its WH-1000XM4 headphones. This follows the recent release of its expensive Collexion headphones. The rumored headphones promise similar performance at a lower price.

headline: Birdfy's smart bird feeder is on sale for just $60
summary: The Birdfy Feeder Rookie smart bird feeder is now available for $59.99. This sale price is close to its lowest point ever. It's an excellent option for new birdwatchers or those on a budget.

headline: Samsung's Z Fold 8 Ultra is more of the same, but better than ever
summary: Samsung's Z Fold 8 Ultra is its first foldable with the 'Ultra' name. It retains the signature thin outer and square inner screen design. The device offers improved performance while sticking to a familiar form factor.

headline: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick Won't Rule Out GTA 6 on Disc at Some Point, Insists Decision Had Nothing to Do With Concern Over Leaks
summary: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick hasn't ruled out a future physical release for GTA 6. He denies the digital-only launch was due to concerns over leaks. This follows the surprise decision against an on-disc release at launch.

headline: Pricing Has Not Kept Pace With Inflation — Take-Two Boss Insists Rockstar Got GTA 6 Standard and Ultimate Edition Price Points Right
summary: GTA 6's standard edition costs $80, a $10 increase from typical AAA games. Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick justifies the price hike due to inflation. He believes Rockstar priced both standard and ultimate editions correctly.

headline: Fortnite is Keeping Sprites for Next Season, a Gaming-Themed Crossover Expected to Feature Sonic, Persona and Tetris
summary: Fortnite's popular Sprites feature will continue into the game's next season. The upcoming season is expected to be gaming-themed. Crossovers with Sonic, Persona, and Tetris are anticipated.

headline: Take-Two Boss Defends No Disc Version of GTA 6, Equates Physical Releases to Vinyl Records
summary: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick defended the digital-only launch of GTA 6. He argues physical discs 'don't really make sense for the consumer.' Zelnick controversially compared physical releases to vinyl records.

headline: How police let a registered sex offender murder and attack women
summary: A senior Met officer admitted Sheryl Wilkins' murder by Simon Levy could have been prevented. Levy was a registered sex offender under police monitoring. The case highlights serious failings in police oversight.

headline: Serial sex offender guilty of murdering two women and raping third
summary: Simon Levy, a serial sex offender, has been found guilty of two murders and one rape. He was actively being monitored by the Metropolitan Police. The verdict concludes a horrific case of police oversight failure.

headline: Cambridge to review process for hiring senior academics after Jason Arday resignation
summary: Cambridge University will review its senior academic hiring process. This follows the resignation of Professor Jason Arday. A group member criticized the university for 'marking its own homework.'

headline: US appeals court halts Trump ballroom project paving way for Supreme Court showdown
summary: A US appeals court halted a Trump ballroom project. The court stated Congress should decide on such a 'massive ballroom.' This decision could lead to a Supreme Court challenge.
